content.short: Fiamma is a trustless verification layer utilizing ZK-proofs for advanced Bitcoin interoperability.
content.description: Fiamma is a cutting-edge infrastructure protocol that brings trustless programmability and interoperability to the Bitcoin network. By leveraging zero-knowledge proofs (ZK-proofs), the platform creates a secure verification layer that enables complex smart contract execution without compromising Bitcoin's base layer security. This architectural design allows developers to build sophisticated cross-chain applications and decentralized finance tools directly utilizing BTC.
